instruction: Load rect_pocket_block.step. Open the part in FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad`, then carry out the Path workbench edits when working on `rect_pocket_block.step`. It is a 120 x 80 x 18 mm block in source coordinates X=-60..60 mm, Y=-40..40 mm, Z=0..18 mm, with one centered 50 x 30 mm pocket whose floor is Z=8.000 mm. Create an editable native FreeCAD 0.21.2 Path/CAM Job. Use G54 matching the source CAD coordinates: X0 Y0 at the block center and Z0 at the block bottom. Configure the stock as the complete 120 x 80 x 18 mm outer block. Use exactly one active native Pocket Shape cutting operation and no other cutting operations. Its ToolController must use T1, an 8 mm flat end mill, tool number 1, Forward spindle at S8000 rpm, and horizontal cutting feed F600 mm/min; use a positive safe vertical feed no greater than the horizontal feed. Set StartDepth to 18 mm, FinalDepth to 8.000 mm, maximum StepDown to 2 mm, and FinishDepth to 0.100 mm, so the penultimate fully cleared floor is Z=8.100 mm and the final fully cleared floor finish pass reaches Z=8.000 mm. Safe stepover, pattern, cut direction, approach, retract, and heights may be chosen as appropriate, but the complete 50 x 30 mm pocket must be cleared without gouging below Z=8.000 mm or outside the pocket. Use the native LinuxCNC postprocessor. Save the editable FreeCAD document and its matching postprocessed output using exactly these absolute paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-4.FCStd and /home/user/Desktop/task-4.nc.
